name: Working On Sunday
overview: Scripture clearly commands the observance of the Sabbath as a holy day of rest, as seen in Exodus 20:8 and Exodus 35:2, where work is prohibited on the seventh day. The seriousness of this command is underscored by the example in Numbers 15:32 of a man found gathering sticks on the Sabbath. However, Jesus teaches that the Sabbath was made for the benefit of man, not as a burden, emphasizing its purpose rather than legalism (Mark 2:27). Jesus Himself worked on the Sabbath, showing that God's work continues (John 5:17), and the early church gathered for worship and teaching on the first day of the week, indicating a shift in practice without neglecting the principle of rest and worship (Acts 20:7).
